name: 03052 · Litchfield, NH
findings: ZIP 03052 (Litchfield) has 19 nonprofit organizations. 4 of them (21%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
